_about: Step-1 feed finder results (2026-11-13), found via web search and checked per name. confidence: high = official + URL seen in results; med = plausible but a handle/ID came from a third-party mirror or the identity is inferred; low = nothing of their own found. Edit the sheet, not this file - the sheet is the source of truth after the first write.
